speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with mental status changes; to begin my assessment, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and what specific changes in your behavior or thinking are you noticing?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Carbon monoxide poisoning (suggested by altered mental status, 30 pack-year smoking history, and acute confusion). Please confirm if the patient was recently in a poorly ventilated space or near a fire. REQUEST TEST: Carboxyhemoglobin level, CBC, CMP.
